catalog_name: Bangladesh BDIX FTP & Movie Server Directory
source: User-provided BDIX FTP Server List (copied as supplied; not independently checked)

ftp.name: FTP Servers
ftp.description: FTP/file/download/NAS and general server endpoints listed by the source. URLs may use HTTP or HTTPS; this category does not imply the ftp:// transport protocol.

movies.name: Movie & Media Servers
movies.description: Movie, media-library, Emby/Jellyfin-style, Plex, Flix, cinema and streaming-oriented endpoints.

classification_notes: ISP/provider websites and social links are stored separately from classified server endpoints when their role was clear in the source.
The ftp category is a directory grouping for file/download/NAS/general server links; many source URLs use HTTP or HTTPS and are not necessarily FTP-protocol URLs.
Movie/media categorization uses the supplied ISP/service names, hostnames, URL paths and recognizable media-server indicators such as port 8096.
Category assignment is an organizational estimate, not live content inspection. Review ambiguous endpoints before production use.
All endpoints are unverified; a URL being listed does not mean it is online, reachable, or BDIX-accessible now.
Private and ISP-local IP addresses are preserved exactly as provided.
Duplicate source entries and repeated URLs across different ISP entries are not silently removed.
